newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV TAKE OVER AT THE TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV TAKE OVER AT THE TOP.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven came from behind to beat Sparta Rotterdam 2-1 on Thursday and regain top spot in the Dutch first division.
Sparta stunned PSV in the 10th minute when Jochem van der Hoeven took advantage of an error in the defence.
The Rotterdammers, who beat PSV twice last season, kept their goal in tact until a few seconds before halftime when PSV defender Jaap Stam headed home a Wim Jonk corner.
Brazilian striker Marcelo scored the winner in the 65th minute when he slotted in the rebound from a Luc Nilis free kick.
Sparta ended the match with 10 men after midfielder Michael Renfurm was sent off in the 85th minute for a professional foul.
PSV lead the league with 36 points from 15 matches, followed by Feyenoord with one point less.
Defending champions Ajax Amsterdam, who are struggling to hit their best league form, had another setback in midweek when they were held 2-2 at home by lowly Fortuna Sittard.
Ajax trail the leaders by nine points.
